nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances in StakeAndFarm.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking approval allowances.
Total token supply, set once in constructor.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; used in privileged require checks.
Public payable transfer() that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom() guarded by the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier; performs unchecked balance and allowance subtraction.
Public payable approve() writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Public privileged function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with bytes b.
Public privileged batch transfer that computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath and loops over recipients.
StakeAndFarm constructor assigning roles, supply, and initial balances/allowance.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-style pair address via keccak256.
Modifier restricting transferFrom participants to a hardcoded whitelist of privileged addresses plus the computed UNI pair.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and balance/allowance accounting.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) forwarding arbitrary calldata and executing foreign code in the contract context.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length, allowing integer overflow.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Recipient address parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Spender address parameter of approve().
Target address parameter of delegate(), used as delegatecall destination.
Raw calldata parameter of delegate(), forwarded to delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend().
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend().
Local variable computed as _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Loop index of the batchSend() recipient iteration.
Per-iteration recipient address copied from _tos[i].
Local address in the modifier holding the computed Uniswap pair address.

edges.reason: transfer() internally calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument to transferFrom inside transfer().
_to argument flows into transferFrom call made by transfer().
_value argument flows into transferFrom call made by transfer().
The SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier gates execution of transferFrom().
_from parameter is used for allowance and balance accounting in transferFrom().
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_value parameter drives allowance and balance updates in transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared against _from and used to index allowance, controlling the spend path.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs unchecked subtraction on balances and allowance.
_from indexes the balance slot that is decremented unchecked.
_value is subtracted unchecked from balance and allowance.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve().
approve() writes into the allowance mapping.
delegate() authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to a set of privileged addresses.
delegate() reads the owner state variable in its authorization require.
delegate() performs an external low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address, enabling arbitrary code execution and reentrancy.
Parameter a becomes the delegatecall target, allowing a privileged caller to hijack contract storage.
Parameter b is forwarded as the raw calldata of the delegatecall.
batchSend() authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to privileged addresses.
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
_tos.length is a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
_value is the multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
batchSend() performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
Local total (possibly overflowed) is subtracted unchecked from the sender balance.
batchSend() reads and credits balanceOf for each recipient.
Loop index i controls iteration in batchSend().
Local _to receives _tos[i] and is credited inside the loop.
Local UNI holds the computed pairFor address used in the modifier whitelist check.
The modifier calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor uses msg.sender to set owner and the initial balance.
Constructor assigns the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to is only used as an argument forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
Parameter _value is only used as an amount argument forwarded from transfer() into transferFrom().
Parameter _from is consumed entirely inside transferFrom() for allowance/balance accounting.
Parameter _to is used only as the credited recipient inside transferFrom().
Parameter _value drives the unchecked subtraction operation inside transferFrom().
Parameter _spender is used only as the allowance key inside approve().
Parameter a is the direct target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter b is the raw calldata passed into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Array _tos supplies _tos.length to the unchecked multiplication.
Parameter _value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
Local total is the value subtracted unchecked from the sender's balance.
Loop counter i exists only to drive batchSend()'s iteration.
Local _to holds the loop recipient used solely within batchSend().
Local UNI holds the pairFor result used only by the modifier's whitelist require.
